passage:
compostable — 可堆肥的，可生物降解的
The policy required all food stalls in the weekly market to use only compostable containers.

stallholders — 摊位经营者
Many stallholders, unable to afford the higher cost of compostable containers, simply stopped selling hot food.

revenue — 收入，收益
As a result, the market's overall waste decreased, but so did its revenue and visitor numbers.

unintended — 意外的，非故意的
These examples illustrate a common problem in policy design: unintended consequences.

indicator — 指标
This outcome shows how a narrow focus on one environmental indicator can obscure broader social and economic effects.

consult — 咨询，商议
First, they should consult the people affected before implementing a rule.

subsidy — 补贴
Stallholders could have suggested a subsidy for compostable containers, and students could have been involved in designing a healthier canteen menu.

evaluation — 评估
Careful planning, broad consultation, and flexible evaluation are needed to turn a well-meant idea into effective action.
